title: packet-btle: Split dissection of CIS and ACL PDUs
description:
The PDUs are different and the code therefore becomes simpler
to maintain when the code is split into separate parts.

The retransmission detection logic for CIS is removed
as it is not correct  all cases as sequence numbers
may be increased even if the peer is not acking the packet.

Signed-off-by: Rubin Gerritsen <rubin.gerritsen@nordicsemi.no>

commits_data.title: packet-btle: Remove unused fields from connection info structs
commits_data.message:
packet-btle: Remove unused fields from connection info structs

The fields except access address are unused.
We do not need to store the access address as this is available
when looking up items from the tree.

Signed-off-by: Rubin Gerritsen <rubin.gerritsen@nordicsemi.no>

commits_data.message:
packet-btle: Split ISO and ACL connection info trees

These connections are of different types and should therefore
not be mixed.
It alos avoids having struct members that are unused.
